name: 整列頁首＋標誌置中、導覽連結在左、功能區在右，下緣分隔線
desc: 固定在畫面頂端的整列頁首，往下捲動時隱藏、往上捲動時出現，標誌置中，導覽連結全部排在左側、功能區在右，內容延伸到接近畫面左右邊緣，下緣有分隔線。手機版改為選單按鈕在左、標誌置中，選單面板從頁首下方展開並填滿畫面。
prompt: 建立一個橫跨整個畫面寬的頁首列，固定在畫面頂端：標誌置中，導覽連結全部排成一列放在左側，功能區在右，所有元素在同一水平線上垂直置中；左右兩側的內容延伸到接近畫面左右邊緣，不限於頁面內容寬度。標誌明顯比導覽連結的文字大，但寬度只佔畫面一小部分。功能區可放小型下拉選單、文字連結或圖示按鈕，沒有時省略，其他元素的位置不變。頁首下緣有一條橫跨全寬的分隔線。往下捲動時頁首往上滑出隱藏，往上捲動時滑回出現，滑回時疊在內容上方。功能區的小型下拉選單點開後，在它正下方展開一個小面板，壓在下一個區塊上方。
mobile: 頁首上只留選單按鈕在左、標誌置中，右側保留功能區的一個圖示按鈕和一個文字連結，沒有時省略；導覽連結收進選單面板：點選單按鈕後，選單面板從頁首下方往下展開，橫跨整個畫面寬並填滿頁首以下的畫面，頁首列留在面板上方，選單按鈕變成關閉按鈕。面板內導覽連結直向排列、靠左，面板頂端與每個項目之間都有分隔線；功能區的其他元素（帶小圖示的文字連結、小型下拉選單）移到面板底部的獨立底區。頁首下緣的分隔線保留，捲動隱藏的行為保留。

en.name: Header bar + logo centered, navigation links on the left, actions group on the right, bottom divider
en.desc: A header bar fixed to the top of the viewport that hides when scrolling down and reappears when scrolling up, with the logo centered, all navigation links on the left and the actions group on the right, content reaching close to the left and right viewport edges, and a divider along the bottom edge. On mobile it becomes a menu button on the left with the logo centered, and the menu panel opens below the header and fills the viewport.
en.prompt: Create a header bar spanning the full width of the viewport, fixed to the top of the viewport: the logo centered, all navigation links in a single row on the left and the actions group on the right, all elements vertically centered on the same horizontal line; the content on both sides reaches close to the left and right viewport edges rather than staying within the page content width. The logo is clearly larger than the navigation link text but takes up only a small part of the viewport width. Optionally place a small dropdown, text links or icon buttons in the actions group; omit them when there is no content, without changing the position of the other elements. A divider spans the full width along the bottom edge of the header. When scrolling down, the header slides up and hides; when scrolling up, it slides back into view, sitting on top of the content when it returns. Clicking the small dropdown in the actions group opens a small panel directly below it, overlapping the next section.
en.mobile: Only the menu button on the left and the logo in the center stay in the header, with one icon button and one text link from the actions group kept on the right; omit them when there is no content. The navigation links move into the menu panel: tapping the menu button opens a menu panel that expands downward from below the header, spanning the full viewport width and filling the viewport below the header; the header bar stays above the panel and the menu button turns into a close button. Inside the panel the navigation links are stacked vertically and aligned left, with a divider at the top of the panel and between every item; the rest of the actions group (a text link with a small icon and a small dropdown) moves to a separate bottom area at the foot of the panel. The divider along the bottom edge of the header is kept, and the hide-on-scroll behavior is kept.
